description: This file sets up custom fields, reports, and permissions for the Italian regional module in ERPNext, including configuration for e-invoicing, fiscal regimes, and VAT options.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup: creates custom fields, report, and permissions.

methods.name: make_custom_fields
methods.description: Defines and creates custom fields for various doctype in the Italian regional module.

methods.name: setup_report
methods.description: Enables and configures the 'Electronic Invoice Register' report.

methods.name: add_permissions
methods.description: Sets permissions for 'Import Supplier Invoice' doctype for various roles.
